title: Polynomial Trajectory
text: Generate polynomial trajectories through waypoints, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, {Method} sets Method for trajectory generation Cubic; {Waypoint source} sets the source for waypoints, {Waypoints} sets the waypoint positions along trajectory n -by- p, {Time points}, {Parameter source} sets the source for waypoints, {Velocity boundary conditions}, {Acceleration boundary conditions} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Time
ports.summary: Time point along trajectory scalar | vector

ports.name: Waypoints
ports.summary: Waypoint positions along trajectory n -by- p matrix

ports.name: TimePoints
ports.summary: Time points for waypoints of trajectory p -element vector

ports.name: VelBC
ports.summary: Velocity boundary conditions for waypoints n -by- p matrix

ports.name: AccelBC
ports.summary: Acceleration boundary conditions for trajectory n -by- p matrix

ports.name: q
ports.summary: Position of trajectory scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: qd
ports.summary: Velocity of trajectory scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: qdd
ports.summary: Acceleration of trajectory scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Waypoints
params.values: Waypoint positions along trajectory n -by- p matrix

params.name: Time points
params.values: Time points for waypoints of trajectory p -element vector

params.name: Method
params.values: Method for trajectory generation Cubic Polynomial (default) | Quintic Polynomial | B-Spline

params.name: Velocity boundary conditions
params.values: Velocity boundary conditions for waypoints zeroes(2,5) (default) | n -by- p matrix

params.values: Acceleration boundary conditions for trajectory n -by- p matrix

params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
